headline: Rep. Debbie Dingell toasted Democratic volunteers and the outgoing Sen. Gary Peters, calling on Michigan to send a message against hate.
health_summary: Dingell included health care in a brief list of values she said volunteers have fought for, citing 'health care for every American when they're sick.' She offered no specifics on any health policy or program.
